annotations.title: Query ATS Career Boards & Hiring Deltas

cleanProvenanceBadge: 100% First-Party & Open Government Licensed (commercial_resell_ok — Zero ToS-violating portal scraping)
description: Read-only, idempotent query of Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby job openings and daily hiring deltas (API key or x402; daily). Pass boards or ats with boardSlug (default includeDelta=false, limit=100, offset=0); returns job records ordered by update time descending. Note: For employer KYB, use query_corporate_registry instead.

boards.description: List of 1 to 20 official ATS job boards to query and compute SHA-256 deltas for.

includeDelta.description: When true, computes daily SHA-256 per-job delta status (new, changed, removed, unchanged).

includeDescriptionText.description: When true, includes normalized plain-text job description excerpts.

limit.description: Result row limit alias (1 to 500, default 100).

maxJobs.description: Maximum total job postings returned across the request (1 to 500).

maxJobsPerBoard.description: Maximum job postings returned per ATS board (1 to 500).

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset (0..10000, default 0). Combine with limit to page through large result sets deterministically.

onlyDeltaChanges.description: When true, filters output to only newly posted, modified, or removed openings.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-11-22T00:00:00Z") to replay all job delta events (new/changed/removed) observed since that timestamp. Defaults to a 24-hour retention window so multiple customers receive identical daily deltas.

name: query_ats_jobs

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this response payload was generated.

items.description: Normalized Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby job openings ordered by update timestamp descending with SHA-256 hiring delta status.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset applied to the matched record slice.

partialResult.description: True only if a live upstream sub-source returned partial coverage.

returnedCount.description: Number of structured records returned in items for this page.

sealStatus.description: TAPP Sigstore Rekor cryptographic Merkle seal status of the dataset.

sha256Digest.description: Deterministic 64-character hex SHA-256 provenance digest of the returned items.

stats.description: Execution telemetry including itemCount, durationMs, and upstream breakdown.

streamId.description: Underlying B2A data stream identifier that fulfilled the query.

success.description: True when the read-only query completed without upstream or validation failure.

toolName.description: Executed MCP tool name for deterministic audit correlation.
